svg.title: On air, rebalanced: desktop 1280 px and phone 390 px (issue #638)
svg.text: On air, rebalanced (desktop 1280 px, phone 390 px) · issue #638
The zones take the main space; Crew actions, Storyboards and Scenes are compact cards in one grid. Shown after Fire on Starting soon. Book shot P16, V7.

Every zone, full screen. Nothing outranks it.
Demo Game Cup, grand final · next round 22:15 (T−15)
Starting soon fires on the item; Champion and the others need none.
A tournament or ceremony item · the item above

svg.text: 1 · The zones take two thirds of the width: what is on air, what waits and why. Zone names (Main hall), never keys; no rank numbers.
2 · Crew actions keep the top right: Announce, Spotlight and the emergency's 2 s hold. On a phone they come first, as today.
3 · Storyboards is one compact card: the running loop with Stop loop and Skip to finale, then one item picker and one Fire… button.
4 · Fire… opens a chooser of the presets the crew may fire. Item times are in the event's clock (22:30), never clipped, with a gap to the button.
5 · After Fire the notice says what happens and when: “Starting soon starts at 22:15, at T−15.” Never just “Fired.”
6 · Scenes is a compact card under Crew actions: each zone's scene and the crew's scene buttons.
7 · Two rows that end level: no column runs much longer than the others (P16 had one 1,900 px column on the right).

g.text: What every zone shows now, what waits, and why.

svg.text: Phone, before Fire: crew actions first.
6 zones, desktop 1280 px: one auto-fill grid (cards at least 18 rem wide)
Crew actions, Storyboards, the six zone cards and Scenes are siblings in one grid, in the phone's order. The grid fills as many columns as fit, so the page stays level at any zone count.
At 1920 px the same grid fills five columns; on a phone one.
